# @three-ws/agent-sniper

> Lightweight, embeddable pump.fun sniper engine for 3D AI agents — multi-agent, multi-user, with pluggable wallet/store/RPC adapters. Library + CLI + MCP server + x402 paid API.

@three-ws/agent-sniper is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/agent-sniper`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/solana-sniper-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/solana-sniper-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/solana-sniper-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/solana-sniper-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
